elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: Section 31(a) requires commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.

elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: Section 31(a) requires commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 31(b) requires professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 31(c) requires USD 5,000,000 of cyber liability insurance covering Client Content and other Client or customer data processed, hosted, or transmitted by TrueLink.

elements.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
elements.evidence: Section 31(d) requires workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law.

elements.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must provide Client certificates of insurance evidencing the required coverage upon request.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The required USD 2,000,000 professional liability limit exceeds the USD 1,000,000 fallback threshold.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The required USD 5,000,000 cyber liability coverage for Client and customer data exceeds the USD 2,000,000 fallback threshold.
